risk_note: RV2 migration (withdraw lane B2-05b; model Claude Fable 5.1). Two new tables of the payout module: app.withdrawals (money columns bigint fen with net_fen = amount_fen - fee_fen - tax_fen as a CHECK, payee snapshot fixed at creation, the seven withdrawal_status values with per-state consistency CHECKs, out_biz_no unique per app and refused on any UPDATE by trigger, named count indexes by user and by payee HMAC, column-level grants: couli_app review / hold / block / manual-resolution columns, couli_payout payout-outcome columns, nobody the money, identity, snapshot or out_biz_no columns) and app.withdraw_holds (stacked reasons, released one by one). Generated db/schema.sql and packages/db/src/db.gen.ts from the test machine's db:snapshot. tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts lock list gains the two tables (additions only). Invariant 06 (frozen_fen = sum of open withdrawals, driven by the union of ledger accounts and users with open withdrawals) written by Codex. 59 rule tests (test/spec/db/payout/**) red on the test machine at the spec commit and green with the migration; the daily-check frozen test [AC-B2-02j#7] now counts only invariant 01 differences (test-change B2-05g, #1218).
